advisor_ref.digest_head:
# Hat wave synthesis — role-description-in-prompt

Seats opened: 1 of 5 (`hat-facts-gaps`). The narrowed scope and its reason are
decision-logged: the ask is one cell and one variable, so the wave's threshold
("big, vague, or high-risk"; five dispatches on a small change is the named
ceremony-capture failure) did not carry the other four seats. The one real
risk was a wrong row in the claims table, and the claims-table audit is
`hat-facts-gaps`' own named instrument.

Seats dropped: `hat-alterna

cells.title: Carry the role description into every dispatched prompt
cells.action: Factor the description lookup so ONE home returns the role's trimmed FULL description text, and leave the 60-char display cap at the model-guard door that needs it (D3; the lookup lives at hooks/model_guard.rs:449-467 today and its production caller narrows the config three ways at :532-540 — team, then models, then the config object itself; carry that fallback). Add `role` and `role_description` vars to `prompt_body_for` (prepare.rs:1035-1123) and supply BOTH in BOTH render arms — the non-cell arm and the cell arm — because a bare {{NAME}} surviving pass 2 with no value refuses the dispatch. Resolve both at the one call site (prepare.rs:2269) from `cfg`, the folded raw config already in scope at :1932, keyed on `marker_role`. Suppress the whole block when the dispatch is a hat seat, keyed on the SEAT name not the marker role (D7; prepare.rs:2263 shows they diverge for a fallen-through hat, and the existing `hat_seat` resolution at :2263-2266 is the condition to reuse). Add the `{{#if role_description}}` block to all four templates, modelled on the existing `{{#if seat}}` block in advisor.md, with the joining prose IN the template and the role named there. Finally write the same four template bytes to .bee/bin/prompts/ (D8) — prompt_skew checks both copies and refuses on either mismatch.

truths: A dispatch whose role carries a description renders that description, trimmed and UNTRUNCATED, in the worker prompt — proven with a description longer than 60 characters
A role with no description, a blank one, or a whitespace-only one renders the prompt byte-identically to before this change — one test per render arm
An escalated (ceiling) dispatch carries no description block
A hat-* dispatch carries no description block, including a hat seat that fell through to the advisor slot
The lookup finds the role table under `team`, under `models`, and at the config root
The door's own rendered line is unchanged — its 60-char cap still applies

artifacts.substantive: carries a {{#if role_description}} block naming the role; no TODO
carries the same block, placed beside the existing seat block

key_links: prompt_body_for supplies role and role_description in BOTH render arms
the call site resolves both from the folded raw config keyed on marker_role
the hat suppression reuses the existing hat_seat resolution, keyed on the seat name
prohibitions: No edit to a_hat_advisor_prompt_differs_from_the_plain_one_only_by_its_seat_block — it must pass as written
No change to ROLE_DESCRIPTION_MAX or to what the door line renders
No joining prose composed in Rust — the template owns the wording
No edit to the grammar corpus in devtools/prompts.rs
